import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long input;
    static int answer = 1000000000;

    static void recurse(long num, int cost) {
        if (cost >= answer) return;
        if (num == 0) {
            answer = cost;
            return;
        }
        long rep = 1;
        int len = 1;
        while (rep * 10 + 1 <= num) {
            rep = rep * 10 + 1;
            len++;
        }
        recurse(num % rep, cost + len * (int)(num / rep));
        recurse(rep * 10 + 1 - num, cost + len + 1);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        input = sc.nextLong();
        recurse(input, 0);
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
